proof_0169.moves: A `think` in a weak sequence is literally a `cons` of `none` at the underlying Seq level, so appending after a think is exactly the Seq-level cons_append lemma; there is no argument beyond that identification.

proof_0170.moves: An OfNat numeral at a matrix type is a diagonal (scalar) matrix, and the adjacency matrix has zero diagonal, so this is a direct instance of the general Hadamard-with-a-diagonal-matrix-is-zero lemma. No new content.

proof_0171.moves: Unfold `bne a b` as `!(a == b)`, then transport the given equality of propositions through `beq` using the already-proved beq version, and push the boolean negation through by congruence. Mostly rewriting; the proof term is simp scaffolding.

proof_0172.moves: Given that F f is an isomorphism, it is in particular mono and epi; pull both back along F using the reflection hypotheses to get that f is mono and epi; conclude f is an isomorphism because C is balanced.

proof_0173.moves: A linear map is a bundled additive-hom-like object, so additivity is just the generic FunLike `map_add` specialised; the proof is a one-line reindex of an existing general lemma.

proof_0174.moves: Connectedness is preconnectedness plus nonemptiness of the vertex type; build the structure for the larger graph by pushing preconnectedness forward along the edge inclusion and carrying the nonemptiness over unchanged.

proof_0175.moves: A simps-generated component equation for the inverse of the automorphism-group isomorphism induced by a fully faithful functor. Both sides unfold to the same term, so the proof is definitional (rfl); there is no mathematical step at all.

proof_0176.moves: Unfold rtakeWhile as reverse-takeWhile-reverse, rewrite the membership hypothesis using membership-in-a-reverse, and then apply the takeWhile version of the statement to the transported hypothesis.

proof_0177.moves: Case split on n: when n = 0 the NeZero hypothesis is contradicted and the goal is dispatched by False elimination; when n is a successor both sides are definitionally equal so rfl closes it. The real content is the case split, which no citation names.

proof_0178.moves: The map x |-> x * c is monotone (identity times a constant, using right-multiplication monotonicity), and a monotone map on a linear order commutes with max; apply that and flip the resulting equation.

proof_0179.moves: The kernel is defined as the preimage of the identity, so membership in it unfolds definitionally to the equation f x = 1; the proof is Iff.rfl and carries no argument.

proof_0180.moves: Repackage the pointwise hypothesis 'g x = 1 implies x is in the range of f' as the subgroup inclusion ker g <= range f (which is definitionally the same statement) and hand it to the ker-version of the exactness criterion.

proof_0181.moves: The order dual carries the same multiplication and toDual is the identity function, so right-regularity of toDual a is literally the same proposition as right-regularity of a; the proof is Iff.rfl.

proof_0182.moves: A component equation for the oplax structure map of the monoidal functor induced on discrete categories by an additive monoid hom. By construction that map is eqToHom of the map_add equation, so the proof is rfl -- pure definitional unfolding.

proof_0183.moves: The FunLike coercion of a non-unital algebra hom is, by the chain of structure projections down to MulActionHom.toFun, literally the same function as its toFun field; the proof is rfl.

proof_0184.moves: Write the domain restriction as f composed with the subtype coercion, split the image of the composite, use image-of-preimage equals intersection with the range, and identify the range of the subtype coercion with the set s.

proof_0185.moves: Direct instance of the cancellation law a + b - a = b with a = 1; nothing else happens.

proof_0186.moves: The edge set of a subgraph is the symmetric-relation-to-Sym2 construction applied to its adjacency, and mapping a subgraph along a graph hom takes the relational image of that adjacency; the general lemma that fromRel of a relation image is the Sym2-image of fromRel gives the result at once.

proof_0187.moves: This is the reassoc-generated variant: take the base lemma (which is rfl, since in a preorder-as-category hom-sets are proofs), whisker it on the right by an arbitrary further morphism, and reassociate. The only genuine step is mechanical whiskering plus associativity.

proof_0188.moves: Reduce equality of two equivariant maps to a pointwise statement by extensionality, then compute: composing with the identity map applies id to f x, which is f x.

proof_0189.moves: A simps-generated coercion equation for the order hom lifted to WithTop: the lift is defined with WithTop.map of the underlying function as its toFun, so the equation holds by rfl. No mathematical step.

proof_0190.moves: Extract one direction of the already-proved iff that a covering relation in the order dual is the reversed covering relation; the proof is just Iff.mpr applied to that iff (an alias).

proof_0191.moves: A simps projection equation for the postcomposition functor of a bicategory: its action on a 2-morphism is defined componentwise by whiskering, so evaluating the resulting natural transformation at a 1-morphism is rfl.

proof_0192.moves: Build the OrderIsoClass instance on order isomorphisms: its only field, that the map preserves and reflects <=, is exactly the map_rel_iff' field already carried by the underlying relation isomorphism.
